versions.subject: Suspicious flash player download location / BadRabbit
versions.detection:
selection:
    cs-uri-query: 
        - '*/install_flash_player.exe'
        - '*/flash_install.php*'
filter:
    cs-uri-query: '*.adobe.com/*'
condition: selection and not filter
